mapper.select: SELECT id, space_id, event_id, accepting_applications, setup::text AS setup, completion_notice FROM forms WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT id, space_id, event_id, accepting_applications, setup::text AS setup, completion_notice FROM forms WHERE id = #{formId} AND space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT id AS field_id, kind, system_key, label, position, answer_type, required, description, config::text AS config, show_when::text AS show_when, hidden, preset_key, preset_state::text AS preset_state FROM fields WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND form_id = #{formId} ORDER BY ${orderByClause}
